name: run_deseq2
description: Run DESeq2 differential expression analysis using pydeseq2 (Python implementation). Input: count matrix + metadata. Output: DE genes with LFC, p-values, FDR. For R's original DESeq2, use code_executor with tool='R'.

parameters.counts_path: string — path to count matrix file (genes x samples, TSV/CSV)
parameters.metadata_path: string — path to sample metadata CSV (samples x conditions)
parameters.condition_col: string — metadata column with condition labels (default 'condition')

returns: dict with n_significant, top_upregulated, top_downregulated genes (LFC, pvalue, padj), output CSV path
